name: Crude inflation-impulse x crypto momentum — the inflation-hedge narrative (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-MARKET cross-metric (wti_crude x crypto momentum). Crude oil is the cleanest real-time inflation/growth impulse: a sharp WTI surge feeds an inflation narrative under which crypto (the 'digital gold / inflation hedge' story) often catches a bid as a non-sovereign store of value. The hypothesis is conditional, not unconditional: a rising oil impulse only pays for crypto when crypto's OWN price is already confirming the narrative (momentum up). Mechanism before data: long spot when wti_crude crosses UP through a fitted level (inflation impulse, read via the cross direction since the raw level is non-stationary) AND crypto ret over a window is positive; exit when crypto momentum fades or barriers fire. Distinct from cross-market-dollar-weak-momentum (FX/dollar axis), nasdaq-risk-appetite (equity tech axis), and g2-gold-riskoff-short (gold safety axis, short) — crude is a distinct commodity/inflation axis. Disconfirmer 1: drop the WTI arm — if bare crypto momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the inflation impulse adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: the inflation-hedge story is fragile and regime-dependent (crypto often trades as a risk asset, not a hedge); if substituting gold for crude does as well, this is a generic 'real-asset up' read, not a crude-specific impulse. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): WTI daily next-day-available (Stooq); net of ~20bps the move must clear. tier0 wti_crude + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: wti_crude crosses up (inflation/growth impulse) WHILE crypto momentum confirms the hedge narrative — long spot
